other_checks.rustfmt: Every file ADDED by this round is rustfmt --edition 2021 clean (verified by diffing the formatter's output against the file and confirming zero differing lines). theme.rs, terminal.rs, terminal_colors.rs and agent_session.rs carry PRE-EXISTING formatting debt (theme.rs 679 unclean lines at HEAD vs 663 now; agent_session.rs 360 blocks at HEAD and 360 now); no line added by this round is unclean.

other_checks.dead_code: New todo!()/unimplemented!() introduced: 0. Two #[allow(dead_code)] attributes and the dead helpers they hid were removed.

dependency_release_age: All four additions were checked against crates.io version metadata on 2026-09-14; all exceed seven days and are not yanked.
outstanding: Nine slash commands remain unhandled: btw, fork, logout, scoped-models, share, side, traces, tree, update. Each carries a verified TypeScript citation in tests/slash_command_matrix.json (32 OK / 1 DIVERGES / 9 UNHANDLED of 42 rows). /mcp is the remaining DIVERGES (needs subcommands, interactive-mode.ts:8906-8950). /logout cannot be wired correctly as written: auth_flows.rs:412 run_logout opens an overlay with a default handle and returns None without removing credentials, so wiring it would fake success. Idle eviction has no sweep: daemon_supervisor.rs:25-28 imports can_evict_worker / IdleEvictionMinutes / SessionEvictionSnapshot / WorkerEvictionSnapshot and never uses them (daemon-supervisor.ts:1088-1101).
limitations: No daemon end-to-end coverage in process: daemon_drivable_in_process=false is asserted as fact in the soak suite, which names tests/native_cli.rs as that path's owner.

The slash-command matrix proves classification, handler presence and recorded behaviour. It does not capture live rendered terminal output (native_host is pub(crate) and the TUI daemon is unusable in this environment).
Style-leak and 29 tui-render cases are graded by code-path equivalence only: the TypeScript checks read @xterm/headless and the port has no VT emulator.
Overlay compositing, terminal handoff, stdin_buffer, mouse, terminal_image and render_cache have no fixture coverage; pr18_rendering.json covers utils/markdown/latex only.
Formatting debt predates this round and was deliberately not reformatted, to keep the fixes reviewable.
PR #18 stays open and must be reconciled without being merged blindly.
